import.title: Import data
import.intro: Load or update locations, assets, parts and stock, people, suppliers and PM from one Excel workbook. Rows are matched by code: a new code adds a record, a known code updates it. Blank cells keep the current value and nothing is deleted (set Active to No instead). Up to 25 MB, 20,000 rows a sheet and 30,000 in all.
import.nothing: The file has no sheet CMX knows. Use the template's sheet names.
import.done: Import finished. Rows saved: {{saved}}. Rows skipped for problems: {{skipped}}.
import.waiting: Waiting for another import to finish
import.goesOn: This goes on in the background: you can leave this page. A long one e-mails you when it's done.

pr.orderHint: Lines for the same supplier and site go on one draft order. Prices start from the estimate, else the part's last price.
pr.requestPurchaseHint: Ask purchasing to buy what's short
pr.requestsCreated_one: Request {{numbers}} created as a draft. Open it to check and submit.
pr.requestsCreated_other: Requests {{numbers}} created as drafts. Open them to check and submit.
pr.noLinesToOrder: No approved lines are waiting to be ordered.

approvals.levelsHint: An order needs every level whose minimum it reaches, signed lowest first. The most specific levels win: a site's levels for the order's type, else the site's levels for all types, else the organization's for the type, else the organization's for all types. When no level applies, approvers sign within their own limit as before.
approvals.setHint: The organization's levels, or a site's own (which replace the organization's there).
approvals.name: Level
approvals.minAmountHint: Order total incl. tax and shipping, in {{currency}}.
approvals.none: No levels yet — orders are approved by one person within their limit.

problem.no-site-access: Can't see every site these levels cover

approvals.exampleNone: An order of {{amount}} needs no level: approvers sign within their own limit.
approvals.prRecipientsHint: Told about new purchase requests when the site names nobody. Empty: everyone who may approve requests.
approvals.stuckTitle: Nobody listed can sign this step any more
approvals.stuckBody: An approver left, lost “Approve purchases” or can't see this site. Fix the approval levels, then restart the approval.

myApprovals.title: My approvals
myApprovals.subtitle: Requests and orders waiting for your signature

companies.ratesHint: The company's own rate; categories without one use the category's default.
companies.noCategories: Add contractor categories in Settings first.

contractorCategories.title: Contractor categories
contractorCategories.hint: Kinds of contractor work with a default hourly rate. A company can have its own rate per category.
contractorCategories.rateHint: In {{currency}}; used when the company has no rate of its own.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.alertRecipientsHint: Told when a contract's notice deadline or end is near, besides its manager. With nobody named and no manager, everyone who may manage contracts is told.
contracts.subtitle: Service contracts with their terms, renewals and alerts
contracts.siteHint: Leave empty for a contract covering the whole organization.
contracts.expectedHint: How many work orders the contract should bring.
contracts.autoRenewHint: A new period starts the day after the end, for the renewal length, unless it is stopped in time.
contracts.noticeDaysHint: Days before the end by which the renewal must be stopped.
contracts.alertDaysHint: Days before the notice deadline (or the end) that the contract needs attention.
contracts.noticeDeadline: Last day to stop the renewal
contracts.newValueHint: In {{currency}}; applies to the current period and later renewals.
contracts.noWork: No work orders name this contract.
contracts.terminateHint: Renewal and alerts stop now; the contract shows as terminated from the date you give.
contracts.attentionRenewal: Last day to stop the renewal: {{date}}
contracts.spendNote: Spend on the contract's work is in {{currency}} (Reports › Contracts).
contracts.pickHint: Active and upcoming contracts here; ✓ covers this asset.

contractors.title: Contractors
contractors.none: No contractor work on this order.
contractors.techHint: You can record the hours done, the date and the person. A planner changes the rest.

catalogue.title: Suppliers
catalogue.hint: Who sells this part, in what pack and at what price. Stock is always counted in {{unit}}.
catalogue.none: No suppliers yet. Add one, or choose a preferred supplier on the part.
catalogue.packHint: What the supplier sells, e.g. Box of 100
catalogue.noPartsSupplied: No parts in this supplier's catalogue yet.
catalogue.notCataloguePrice: Not a catalogue price: estimated from today's cost per piece.
catalogue.refilled: Lines refilled from the supplier's catalogue: {{parts}}

availability.title: Availability
availability.subtitle: Time away and extra time, by person or team. The planning board counts it in each person's hours.
availability.add: Add time away or extra time
availability.none: No time away or extra time from this date.
availability.daysHint: None = every day in the range
availability.hoursHint: Empty = the whole working day (time away only)

timesheet.title: Timesheet
timesheet.subtitle: Hours per work order for one person's day, the same entries as each work order's Labour tab.
timesheet.nothing: No work and no hours on this day.
timesheet.otherWorkOrder: Add hours on another work order
timesheet.weekHint: Logged hours / hours available. Red: more than available; orange: less. Click a day to open it.

techDay.title: My day
techDay.nothing: No jobs and no hours on this day.

costCentres.title: Cost centres
costCentres.hint: Where maintenance cost is charged. Work orders take the cost centre of their asset or location; budgets are set per cost centre and month.
costCentres.siteHint: Leave empty to use it at every site.
costCentres.inactiveHint: Inactive cost centres aren't offered for new records but stay on old ones.
costCentres.fillInHint: Work orders and parts issued to locations from this date that have no cost centre get the one in force today. Nothing that already has a cost centre changes, and you can run it again.
costCentres.fillInCount: Work orders to fill in: {{workOrders}} · direct issues: {{issues}}
costCentres.filled: Filled in: {{workOrders}} work orders, {{issues}} direct issues
costCentres.changeHint_one: The work order's labour, parts, contractors, other costs and orders move with it. It works in any status and shows in its history.
costCentres.changeHint_other: The {{count}} work orders' labour, parts, contractors, other costs and orders move with them. It works in any status and shows in their history.
costCentres.locationHint: Its assets and places under it use this unless they have their own.
costCentres.assetHint: Empty uses its parent asset's, else its location's.
costCentres.overrideHint: Empty follows the asset or location.
costCentres.workOrderHint: Empty takes the asset's or location's cost centre.
costCentres.directHint: Empty takes the location's cost centre.
costCentres.withChildren: With the cost centres under it

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.subtitle: One amount per cost centre per month, in {{currency}}
budgets.discard: Discard the changes you haven't saved?
budgets.hint: Type a total to spread it evenly over the months. In the report, a cost centre's budget includes the cost centres under it.

lists.title: Lists
lists.hint: Your own names, colours and order for work types, priorities, asset statuses and criticality. Their meaning stays the same, so rules, targets and reports keep working. A hidden value stays on old records but isn't offered for new ones.

brands.title: Brands and models
brands.hint: Picked on assets; an asset keeps the names. Rename one onto another name to merge the two.
brands.mergeQuestion: “{{name}}” is already in the list. Merge the two? Assets move to the one kept.

units.title: Units
units.hint: Picked for parts, measurement points and template steps, which keep the symbol. Case matters: mW isn't MW. A new symbol is written to everything that uses the old one.
units.mergeQuestion: “{{symbol}}” is already a unit. Merge the two?
units.serialTrackedHint: Each piece is a unit with its own serial number, history and running hours.
units.lifeHint: Each unit's end of life is its receipt date plus this.
units.duplicate: The same serial number is entered twice.
units.wrongCount: Enter one serial number for each piece ({{m}}).
units.switchOnIntro: Enter a serial number for each piece in stock: each becomes a unit, with no stock movement.
units.wholePieces: A store holds part of a piece: adjust it to whole pieces first.
units.offIntro: Serial tracking can be switched off once every unit is scrapped.
units.formOn: Serial-tracked: change it with Serial tracking on the part page.
units.formOff: Serial tracking is switched on from the part page, with a serial for each piece in stock.
units.registerFoundHint: A piece found in a store: the stock goes up by one.
units.registerFittedHint: A unit already on a machine: no stock moves.
units.repairCostHint: Counts on the unit, not on the stock value.
units.noHoursMeter: This asset has no meter in hours: the unit's hours won't be counted.
units.noneInStore: No units in store at this site.
units.makeUnitHint: Links this asset (serial {{serial}}) to a serial-tracked part as a fitted unit. No stock moves.
units.repairLineHint: A unit under repair goes to the supplier; receiving the line brings it back to a store with the line's cost.
units.placeLocked: A unit's status, store and place change through fit, remove and the unit actions.

assetGroups.title: Asset groups
assetGroups.hint: Named sets of assets anywhere in the tree, such as kitchen equipment or guest-facing assets. Use them to filter lists and reports, and as a PM target that follows its members.
assetGroups.siteHint: Leave empty to take assets of every site.
assetGroups.assetHint: Groups of this asset's site, or shared ones.
assetGroups.pmHint: The PM follows the group: an asset added later is included from the next visit.

home.nothingYet: Your home page has nothing to show yet. Ask your administrator to set one up for your role.
home.quickRequestText: Something broken or not working? Tell the maintenance team.
home.pickPlace: Pick a site or location to see what you can do there.

empty.my-work: Nothing assigned to you right now.
empty.unassigned-work: Everything open has someone on it.
empty.low-stock: No parts are below their reorder level.

home.pinHint: Pin a saved view to see its count here.
home.cardError: Couldn't load this card. Try again later.

home.classicNote: Cards follow the home page grid, so a page made from today's dashboard looks close to it, not identical.
home.none: No home page: people with this role see the standard dashboard.
home.missing: People with only this role won't see this card: it needs {{perm}}.
home.severalRoles: People with several roles see the cards of all their roles, in role-name order, without repeats.
home.fixTiles: Give every tile a label and a CMX address starting with /.

tile.label: Label
tile.badLink: Use a CMX address starting with /.

menu.note: Hiding a menu item only tidies the menu. People can still open the page from links if their permissions allow it. To stop access, change the role's permissions.
menu.severalRoles: A menu item is hidden for a person when all of their roles that can open it hide it.

columns.none: No default columns for this role.
columns.where: Set a role's default columns from a list's column menu.

cardHints.work-summary: Open, late, due soon, not started, completed and waiting requests.
cardHints.work-by-site: Open and late work at each site.
cardHints.urgent-work: The most urgent open work orders.
cardHints.asset-summary: Assets, assets down, critical, under repair and value.
cardHints.assets-by-status: A chart of assets by status.
cardHints.assets-by-category: A chart of assets by category.
cardHints.assets-by-site: How many assets each site has.
cardHints.warranty-soon: Warranties ending in the next months.
cardHints.my-work: Open work assigned to the person, earliest due first.
cardHints.unassigned-work: Open work with nobody assigned, for whoever hands out work.
cardHints.low-stock: Parts at or below their reorder level.
cardHints.my-approvals: Purchase requests and orders waiting for the person's approval.
cardHints.quick-request: A button to report a problem.
cardHints.location-tree: The sites and locations, with buttons to report, create work or add assets there.
cardHints.shortcuts: Coloured tiles that open CMX pages.

print.accessWindows: When the work can be done
print.firstLabelDecides: These labels use the layout of the first one.
print.title: Print layouts
print.intro: Shape the job card, purchase order, request receipt and labels. With no layout, each paper prints as it always has.
print.isDefaultHint: Prints when no layout for the record's site or type applies.
print.choiceHint: A record prints with the layout for its site and type, then its site, then its type, then the default. Layouts with neither and not the default are picked by hand when printing.
print.noAssetFields: Add asset fields in Settings › Custom fields first.
print.qrAlways: Every label carries its QR code.
print.previewNumber: Number of a record to preview (latest by default)

blocks.access-windows: When the work can be done

techUnits.scanHint: Or type its serial or asset number
techUnits.notHere: Not a unit in store at this job's site.
techUnits.orPick: Or pick a unit in store
techUnits.noDefault: This job's site has no default store: choose repair or scrap, or remove it on the web.

security.title: Security
security.minLengthHint: 8 to 64 characters. People whose password is shorter choose a new one when they next sign in.
security.history: Recent passwords that can't be reused
security.historyHint: 0 to 24. The current password can never be chosen again.
security.oneSessionHint: Signing in on a second device asks first, then ends the other device's session.
security.retentionHint: 12 to 120 months; leave empty to keep everything.
security.retentionNote: Older changes also leave each record's History tab.
security.minLengthRange: Enter a minimum length from 8 to 64.
security.retentionRange: Keep at least 12 months, at most 120, or leave it empty.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.intro: Every change and sign-in in your organization, newest first. Masked values show as ••••.

storage.title: Storage
storage.deletedHint: Files kept with records that were deleted.
storage.search: Search file, record or uploaded by

anonymise.title: Anonymise a person who has left
anonymise.what_one: Their name will be replaced by "{{placeholder}}" in {{count}} record, their e-mail, phone and notes cleared, and their sign-in closed. This can't be undone.
anonymise.what_other: Their name will be replaced by "{{placeholder}}" in {{count}} records, their e-mail, phone and notes cleared, and their sign-in closed. This can't be undone.
anonymise.sameName: Someone else has the same name
anonymise.sameNameKept: Names kept only as text (requested by, signed by, read by, counted by, decided by…) are left unchanged. Copies linked to this person are still replaced.
anonymise.freeText: Names typed inside descriptions and comments aren't changed.

serviceAccounts.intro: An account for another system (an ERP, a BI tool, a sensor gateway), not a person. API keys act as it, with its roles and sites. It can't sign in and gets no e-mail.
serviceAccounts.deleteBody: Its API keys stop working at once. Its changes stay in the history.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.intro: Keys let other systems use CMX as a service account. A key is shown once, when it's made.
apiKeys.noAccounts: Make a service account first, under Users.
apiKeys.readOnlyHint: It can read, but never change anything.
apiKeys.revokeQuestion: Revoke the key "{{name}}"? It stops working at once.
apiKeys.onlyOnce: Copy this key now. You won't see this key again.
